question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus token-budget helpers as the stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold token-budget metadata into the broader assemble-metadata RFC in #82137?
rationale: The code is a public plugin API addition, and automation cannot decide whether this narrow contract should become stable independently of the related RFC.

options.title: Accept the narrow contract after proof
options.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` as an optional assemble field once the SDK baseline is regenerated and live context-engine proof is posted.

options.title: Fold into #82137
options.body: Pause or close this PR and require token-headroom metadata to land with the broader provenance/pre-prompt assemble contract.

options.title: Keep helpers private for now
options.body: Remove public SDK helper exports and keep only internal runtime plumbing until the permanent plugin contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow contract after proof
recommendation.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` as an optional assemble field once the SDK baseline is regenerated and live context-engine proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current rebase and adjacent merged budgeting work, and are already assigned to this API surface.
